name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.3 (TEST): for an embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME container the forward is redirected into a reply (recipients cleared, Re: -> Fwd:); whether Thunderbird carries standalone files (e.g. TEst.txt) into the reply is verified via the parent CompFields probe, and standalone files are now DECRYPTED + re-attached from the parent scope with Thunderbird's own gloda MsgHdrToMimeMessage engine (which, unlike the messages API, descends into embedded rfc822 S/MIME).
